npcs.name: Dad
dialog: Buddy, what's going on? Is she at it again?

topics.label: Why do we have only one bed?
lines: I sleep on the wheelchair, you know it.

chat.prompt: Why did the chicken crossed the road?

choices.label: You are such a boring old man
Dad, why did the chicken crossed the road?

services.label: Could you fix up my gear?

dad.title: Pay her a visit
offer: Go up there and pay our neighbour a visit. She's never been SO loud. I can't hear my own thoughts! Go talk to her.
dad.progressLine: Just go up there and ask her to shut up. She's right above us.

say: Go out the apartment, stairs up, first door to the left. I always new you are a dimwit.
Will ya do it or should I do it myself!?

dad.title: Kill the bitch
offer: Whats going on? You look pale.
dad.progressLine: Did you pay her a visit?
ready: Talk to me Maro. I head screams and weird sounds.

say: Dead? What happened there. Did you.. ?

choices.label: Yes. She attacked me, dad. She went batshit crazy!

say: Ok, well. At least she will shut up now. Why did you kill her, again?
Attacked you? What the hell is going on. It's all right. You did nothing wrong. It was a self defence.

dad.title: Check the building
offer: Go check her flat again. Maybe there is another one? Then go outside, just check the front of the building. Grab this baseball bat. Just in case.
dad.progressLine: Go. Check her apartment again and see in front of the building.
ready: Good. We need to scout ahead. Look for other people. This building still has 4 more appartments. Those people gotta be somewhere.

dad.title: Bring the toolbox
offer: There's more of them than we thought. You will need better tools. I left a toolbox in our garage. Go get it. And watch out for yourself.
dad.progressLine: Where is my box, you dimwit?
ready: Good. I will be able to fix your stuff before it falls apart. If you have the materials that is.
